title: Downloader TV: APK Installer
summary: Your short codes work here. APK & XAPK installer, TV browser & send from phone.
description:
Same short codes. New interface. More power.

Downloader TV is a downloader, web browser and APK / XAPK installer for Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV. If you already use numeric short codes to put apps on your TV, they work here unchanged: type the code, the file arrives, the installer opens. No ads, no account, no purchases.

WHAT IT DOES

• Short codes — type a code and the download starts. The codes you find in guides and videos work here exactly as you expect, and popular codes are listed right on the screen, so there is less to type with the remote.

• Web browser for TV — a full browser driven by the remote: open any URL, log in to a site, download a file. Big downloads continue in the background and resume if the connection drops.

• APK & XAPK installer — installs APK, XAPK, APKS and APKM files (split APKs / app bundles) in one press. No converter apps, no computer.

• Send from your phone — scan the QR code on the TV with your phone, pick a file, and it lands on the television. Nothing to type with the remote, no cable, nothing to install on the phone — any mobile browser works.

• Local Send — move big files between phone, PC and TV over your own Wi-Fi. Nothing travels through the internet, there is no size limit, and nothing arrives without your OK on the TV screen.

• File manager — browse internal storage, USB drives and SD cards. Copy, move, rename, delete, and clean up finished installer files to free space.

• App manager — every installed app in one list. Open it, uninstall it, or back up its APK to storage or USB.

• Tools — device information (model, Android version, RAM, storage), a network speed test, and a cleaner that frees space.

MADE FOR TELEVISION

This is not a phone app stretched onto a big screen. Every page is drawn for a TV and driven entirely by the D-pad: large text, simple rows, nothing hidden behind a long press. It runs on Android TV and Google TV boxes, sticks and projectors, and on Fire TV devices.

PERMISSIONS, PLAINLY

• Internet — to browse, download the files you ask for, and receive what you send from your phone.
• Storage — to save downloads and to read the files you install, move or send.
• Install unknown apps — to install the APK and XAPK files YOU choose. Android asks for your confirmation every single time.
• List installed apps — so the app manager can show, open and uninstall your apps.

We do not host, sell or distribute any application. Downloader TV only handles files you already have or choose to download, and installs them with your confirmation. It cannot install anything on its own.

FAQ

Q: Do my existing short codes work here?
A: Yes. Type the same numeric codes you already use — they download the same files.

Q: Is this the classic downloader app?
A: No. Downloader TV is an independent app. It understands the same short codes, so switching costs nothing.

Q: Can I install apps from a USB drive?
A: Yes. The file manager finds APK and XAPK files on USB sticks and SD cards and installs them in one press.

Q: Are there ads or paid features?
A: No ads and no in-app purchases. Everything is included.
recentChanges: Opens faster and stops the freeze that could hit right after launch on slower TV boxes: the browser engine no longer starts up while the app is opening. The Edition and About pages now show properly, with a QR code you can scan to leave a review from your phone.
